vibe_rationale: Curated, city-wide design week with an open exhibitor model, but led by the design industry and showrooms rather than a street or community subculture.
fit_notes: Adult, design-literate Tokyo audience across nine districts, with free entry and a published exhibitor route, so a health brand could show a designed space or collaboration. Wellness adjacency is thin, and it is Tokyo-based, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
